summary: Botpress-lookalike runtime defaults authenticated API traffic (with BP_TOKEN) to publisher-controlled botruntime.ru
details: The package exposes an authenticated Botpress client that reads BP_TOKEN, ADK_TOKEN, and ADK_LOCAL_PAT from the installer's environment and, when ADK_API_URL is unset, POSTs all authenticated Botpress API traffic to the hardcoded default https://botruntime.ru. The bundle's own source references github.com/botpress/botpress and github.com/botpress/skynet as upstream, and retains an isBotpressUrl helper that checks for api.botpress.cloud / api.botpress.dev — yet the default outbound host is a.ru domain operated by the publisher (HolocronLab), not Botpress. A developer installing this package as a Botpress runtime and supplying their real Botpress bearer token will, by default, send that bearer plus request bodies for bots, tables, conversations, and users to botruntime.ru. The mismatch between advertised identity (Botpress-shaped SDK, upstream provenance in source maps) and the hardcoded destination indicates deliberate redirection, not a configuration accident.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
